detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Lead your faction through the alien invasion with all the extras in the Terra Invicta Supporter Pack:

  • Digital Original Soundtrack featuring 25 tracks of in-game music composed by Breakdown Epiphanies, in MP3 and uncompressed WAV

  • 10 wallpapers in 4K

  • An 80+ page digital artbook with concept art for the seven factions and the aliens (English only)

How to access the Supporter Pack

All Supporter Pack items can be found in Steam\steamapps\common\Terra Invicta\Supporter Pack
